title: Least Squares Regression Line
body:
The following data shows the relationship between hours studied (x) and test scores (y):

| Hours (x) | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 |
|-----------|---|---|---|---|---|
| Score (y) | 50 | 55 | 65 | 70 | 80 |

Given: $$ ar{x} = 4$$, $$ ar{y} = 64$$, $$\sum(x -  ar{x})(y -  ar{y}) = 50$$, $$\sum(x -  ar{x})^2 = 10$$

Determine the equation of the least squares regression line $$\hat{y} = a + bx$$
